title: Move the midday stand-up from 13:00 for the rest of the week?
detail: Today's 13:00 was moved to 14:30 to 15:00 UTC (London and Lisbon) on the calendar, for today only, at Angelo's word: Dinis is at lunch, and some found 13:00 inconvenient. A permanent change needs everyone to agree. If it moves, team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo moves the calendar series and the debrief run, and data/meetings/schedule.json is changed by its owner (the agenda ids stay as they are).
recommend: 14:30 from Thursday, if nobody objects at today's stand-up
